FILED s543j (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22) while fixing #5210 (`local %ENV`, the same shape: a CL `let` of the exception-set name to a fresh table loses the marker).  PRE-EXISTING.

REPRODUCER (scratch/s543j/probes/file in the s543j worktree (agent-abcd8b98eb856dbee)/t5332.pl):
    { local %INC; require File::Spec; print "1 ", (exists $INC{"File/Spec.pm"} ? "Y" : "N"), "\n"; }
    print "2 ", (exists $INC{"File/Spec.pm"} ? "Y" : "N"), "\n";
  perl: 1 Y / 2 N      PCL: 1 N / 2 Y

MECHANISM: `local %INC` lowers to `(let ((%INC (make-hash-table ...))) ...)`; %INC is normally the %INC-MARKER% whose backing store is *p-inc-table*, which `require` writes.  FIX SHAPE: the #5210 pattern (s543j's p-local-env): a localizer the `local %h` plan selects for %INC (a core variable, rule 9a) that saves *p-inc-table*, clears it / fills it through p-hash-fill's %INC arm, and restores it on exit.  `local /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/site_perl/5.40.3/x86_64-linux /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/site_perl/5.40.3 /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/5.40.3/x86_64-linux /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/perls/perl-5.40.3/lib/5.40.3` is right (probed).  NOTE: PCL's %INC also holds strict.pm at the end of this program where perl's does not (row 2's sibling) -- a separate question, not measured.

=== DONE (s543l) ===
ONE localizer for the three core hashes (rule 11: the three read as one): p-local-store STORE INIT BODY, STORE :env
:inc :sig (s543j's p-local-env became its :env arm), with %p-local-store-save / -fill / -restore (an ecase each, rule
12).  :inc saves the *p-inc-table* OBJECT and installs a fresh table filled by p-hash-fill's %INC arm; the restore puts
the object back under unwind-protect.  The plan selects it by storage name (Parser2 %LOCAL_STORE; `%main::INC` too).
`local $INC{K}` / `delete local $INC{K}` CRASHED on the base (a Lisp type error: the element helpers called gethash on
the %INC marker): %p-inc-elem-local, the element helpers' %INC arm.  Probes scratch/s543l/probes/m4 e01-e09: base 4 ->
tree 9 = perl (a module required in the scope runs again after it, as perl's: the fasl is loaded again; `local %INC =
(%INC, "X.pm" => 1)` fakes a loaded module; do FILE records; a die restores; `local @INC` byte-identical and right).
Guard require-value-01.t 'localinc'.


=== s543l (WIP 6) ===
The companion AFTER run caught one more face: t/op/require_errors.t rows 56-57 (GH #17428) -- `local %INC = %INC`
copied a failed load's UNDEF entry as "" (p-hash-fill's %INC arm stringified every value), and the next require
read it as loaded.  The arm keeps undef (and an odd trailing key's value) undef; on the base those rows passed on
nothing (the plain-table local never reached the store).  Guard require-value-01.t localinc lines 10-11.
